observation_summary: The indexOf method in StrBuilder fails to respect the 'size' variable, searching the entire underlying buffer instead of just the valid string content. hypothesis: The indexOf method in StrBuilder incorrectly uses the buffer's total capacity instead of the current string size to determine the search boundary.
prediction: The indexOf method implementation will show a loop boundary condition based on 'thisBuf.length' rather than 'size'.
